summary: Independently accepted E402. Both frozen product files match the report and canonical Bazel receipt; the focused controller suite passes 31/31; five actual fixture-runtime adversarial cases confirm owner matching, fail-closed identity handling, captured-readonly precedence, payload identity non-authority, and owned public-alias controller edits. Rejected nonowner operations leave the tab-local profile overlay and provider runtime snapshot unchanged.

percases.case: authenticated A views B; toggle and submit with forged owner fields

percases.method: Cleared only controller projection session.teacherId after authenticating; provider fixture identity remains valid.

percases.case: captured readonly precedence under forged owner payload
owned public-profile alias with forged other-owner payload
percases.overlayNameAfterReopen: Demo Avery edited via public alias

findings.controllerGate: Both handlers compare session.teacherId against the loaded profile.teacherId; toggle additionally requires authenticated status. Submit has an earlier authentication guard. Captured readonly rejection remains earlier than owner matching.
findings.UI: Rendered AST/DOM-shaped tree confirms Edit and edit form remain absent on other public-profile routes after rejected actions. An owned /teachers/demo-avery alias also has no rendered Edit affordance because existing renderer uses authenticated && !route.profileId. Controller direct toggle/save still succeeds for the matching owner. This is rendered markup inspection only, not browser visual QA.
findings.providerVsOverlay: All rejected cases preserve provider/runtime snapshots and controller profile value. The successful owner edit changes only the in-memory controller overlay; provider-owned profile remains unchanged.
findings.truthyIdentityContract: Valid fixture records require string IDs beginning demo-; a stored profile teacherId must equal its record ID; session teacherId is derived from the validated record ID or null. Missing empty identity was explicitly exercised and failed closed. Malformed non-string truthy IDs cannot be produced through the checked fixture provider and were not treated as valid real-runtime cases.

limits: Only volatile synthetic fixture accounts and captured reference data were used.
Provider/runtime has no profile-update operation; successful edits remain tab-local overlays. No production/backend authorization or remote data mutation was tested.
Rendered AST/markup checks are not browser DOM mounting or visual QA.
Canonical build report/receipt were verified by identities; no second full canonical build was run.
